analyst_view.overall: Early view: the Derby van het Noorden comes with FC Groningen missing keeper Etienne Vaessen (second yellow at AZ) and Hans Hateboer (red card, one-match settlement accepted); both bans are one match and are served here. Heerenveen arrive on five straight wins including the 5-3 over Feyenoord, while Groningen lost their last two league games (2-3 to Sparta, 4-3 at AZ) and went out of the cup.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals. I lean higher: Groningen's last two league games finished 2-3 and 3-4, a reserve keeper replaces Vaessen, and Heerenveen just scored five against Feyenoord with Ringo Meerveld off the bench.

corners.text: The numbers say 10 corners, split evenly. Groningen press high under Dick Lukkien and Heerenveen are confident going forward, so both should get into the final third; I see nothing to move the figure.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.7 cards. I lean higher: it is the northern derby, Groningen finished their last game with nine men and their own director says Vaessen's temper hurts the team, and the rivalry rarely stays calm.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.8 shots. Two teams who both attack and a home side under pressure to respond fits this volume; I keep it.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10 shots on target. I lean slightly higher because Heerenveen's attack is in its best spell of the season and Groningen have scored through Ondrejka, Willumsson and Van Bergen in recent weeks, so both sides should test the keepers.
